bugReport.title: Stock went negative on the last baguette
bugReport.body: Two customers paid for the last baguette tradition within the same second. The dashboard then showed a stock of -1. Support thinks it started with last week's inventory refactor.

events.line: Court is now in session. The case: the stock of baguettes went negative.

events.speaker: investigator
events.line: The culprit is commit a6fe65a, last week's inventory refactor. The bug reproduces there, as support said.

events.excerpt: AssertionError: expected -1 to be greater than or equal to 0
AssertionError: expected -1 to be greater than or equal to 0

events.speaker: prosecutor
events.line: Objection! Your evidence proves the bug exists at a6fe65a. It does not prove a6fe65a created it.

events.speaker: prosecutor
events.line: The defense forgot the parent commit. Run the same test on 3cabb03, before the refactor.

events.excerpt: AssertionError: expected -1 to be greater than or equal to 0

events.speaker: investigator
events.line: The bug was already there before the refactor. I withdraw the accusation against a6fe65a.

events.speaker: investigator
events.line: Then let the history speak. The test passes at b0cd2b5 and fails today. A bisect will name the commit.

events.excerpt: first bad commit: 1293f22 feat(inventory): back stock with an async inventory store

events.rootCause: reserveStock reads the stock, awaits, then decrements. Two concurrent orders both pass the availability check before either decrement lands.
events.fixSummary: Make the availability check and the decrement a single atomic store operation.
events.line: The court finds commit 1293f22 guilty. Commit a6fe65a is acquitted.
